subject: Embed sidecar circuit breaker: cap Haiku fallback, fail open
description:
In /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid, when the MiniLM embed sidecar (lib/embed-server.js, client lib/embed.js) is unavailable or crashing, gated search falls back to lib/embed-haiku.js — a per-call Anthropic API hit with no cap. A burst of search_knowledge/context-gate calls during a sidecar outage means a burst of paid API calls and multi-second latency on every gate.

Add a circuit breaker in the fallback path (find where embed.js/context-gate decides to use embed-haiku):
- Track recent Haiku-fallback count (e.g. timestamps array or counter+window). If more than N fallbacks in 60s (pick N=3-5), OPEN the breaker: skip Haiku entirely and fail open — return null/abstain so the context gate simply injects nothing (abstain-by-default is already the gate's philosophy; an un-gated empty result is the correct degraded mode, NOT an error).
- Half-open after a cool-down (~5 min): allow one probe fallback; success closes the breaker.
- Log one line on state transitions (open/close), not per call.
- Respect existing behavior when ZONOID_SKIP_LIVE=1 / no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (look at how embed-haiku currently no-ops).

Tests: unit-test the breaker logic (pure function/module if possible) per existing test conventions in test/embed.test.js.
